g.text: Full range, with separate vertical scales for each package. Counts include failed optimizations.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: PyPOMP and Cuthbert: 100 initial values per method. Other packages: 6 initial values x 2 replicates. PyPOMP PF likelihood evaluation, J=5,000.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: Package denotes code supplied by the library; custom denotes code added for this study. Dynamax uses package SSM.fit_sgd with a custom PF. Package PF alone is not a package parameter-estimation method.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: ADPF + Adam: differentiable PF likelihood, alpha 1, 425 updates without IF2 initialization. IFAD starts with IF2; it is a different optimization procedure.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: Boxplots include all finite log likelihood estimates. Bars show +/- 1.96 MCSE. Failed optimizations are plotted at the last valid parameters where available.
